description: "History of the United Netherlands from the Death of William the Silent to the Twelve Years' Truce--1609" by John Lothrop Motley is an extensive historical account composed in the late 19th century. This volume focuses on the significant events between 1585 and 1586, detailing the political intricacies and military conflicts involving the Netherlands, England, and Spain during a pivotal period in European history.
